meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出代码改动的动态架构图,让系统结构一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次审代码都要费劲想象数据怎么流。
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into animated architecture and data-flow diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review big diffs and wish the data flow were drawn for you.

howto.what: PR Lens 把代码改动或代码库的一部分画成带动画的架构图或数据流图，可单独输出，也可放进 pull request。它把 diff 或代码写成一份 JSON 文档，再渲染成动画 SVG。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、可视化或解释某个改动或系统，或希望某个 pull request 带上图时触发；也可用 PR Lens、diagram、architecture 等关键词。

say.text: 把这个分支的改动画成一张架构图
say.note: 读取 diff，生成 JSON 并渲染 SVG

say.text: 给这个已经存在的 PR 加一张数据流图
say.note: 图会上传到 PR 描述里

say.text: 把那张图的队列节点改名，再推一次
say.note: 同一画布更新，链接不变

howto.what_en: PR Lens turns a code change or part of a codebase into an animated architecture or data-flow diagram. It writes the diff or code as one JSON document, then renders it as an animated SVG, on its own or inside a pull request.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. Keywords include PR Lens, diagram and architecture.

say_en.text: Draw this branch's change as an architecture diagram
say_en.note: Reads the diff, renders animated SVGs

say_en.text: Add a data-flow diagram to this existing pull request
say_en.note: Attaches the diagram to the PR body

say_en.text: Rename that queue node and push again
say_en.note: Same canvas updates, link stays the same
